record.question: How much time was taken to draft the constitution of Independent India?
record.explanation: Answer A: 2 years, 11 months and 18 days. The Constituent Assembly took 2 years, 11 months and 18 days to complete the Constitution. Reference: https://loksabhadocs.nic.in/Refinput/New_Reference_Notes/English/Constitution.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
